summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, attaching a press release reporting Q1 2026 results. The filing highlights solid earnings with underlying net income of $1,050M, an increase of $5M from Q1'25, and an underlying return on equity of 18.6%. The release also notes the intention to renew a normal course issuer bid to purchase up to 10 million common shares and an increase in the common share dividend from $0.92 to $0.96 per share. Additionally, the company mentions deploying over $2.4B in capital for buy-ups of BGO and Crescent Capital and announcing an intention to acquire Bell Partners. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation filing.
